elements.description: Who did what and when, for the record – with what changed, before and after – with search, filters by outcome, person, type and date, and export.

properties.name: events
properties.description: What happened, in any order: they show newest first

properties.name: outcome
properties.description: Which outcomes show. Changed by the filter unless a tc-outcome-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: actor
properties.description: Only this person's events; "" for anyone. Changed by the Person filter unless a tc-actor-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: action
properties.description: Only this action; "" for any. Changed by the Type filter unless a tc-action-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: range
properties.description: Only events from "today", the last "7d" or "30d", or "all". Changed by the Date filter unless a tc-range-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: now
properties.description: The time ranges are measured from, epoch ms; unset, the clock's when the range is picked

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The locale for dates and times

properties.name: timeZone
properties.description: The time zone for dates and times; by default the browser's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-actor-change
events.description: The Person filter changed ({ actor }: AuditActorChange; "" is anyone); cancelable – prevented, `actor` stays as it was

events.name: tc-action-change
events.description: The Type filter changed ({ action }: AuditActionChange; "" is any action); cancelable – prevented, `action` stays as it was

events.name: tc-range-change
events.description: The Date filter changed ({ range }: AuditRangeChange); cancelable – prevented, `range` stays as it was

events.name: tc-outcome-change
events.description: The outcome filter changed ({ outcome }: AuditOutcomeChange); cancelable – prevented, `outcome` stays as it was

events.name: tc-export
events.description: Export was pressed ({ events, csv }: AuditExport); cancelable – without a listener preventing it, the file downloads

functions.name: auditChanges
functions.description: The fields an event really changed: a field with the same value before and after is left out

functions.name: auditCsvCell
functions.description: One CSV cell. A leading = + - @ (or tab, return) is a formula to a spreadsheet, so it's kept as text

functions.name: auditCsv
functions.description: The events as CSV, with times in ISO 8601; a changes column ("field: before → after; …") when any event has changes

props.name: actor
props.description: Only this person's events ("" for anyone) – controlled when given

props.name: defaultActor
props.description: The Person filter on mount when `actor` isn't controlled

props.name: action
props.description: Only this action ("" for any) – controlled when given

props.name: defaultAction
props.description: The Type filter on mount when `action` isn't controlled

props.name: range
props.description: The date range – controlled when given

props.name: defaultRange
props.description: The Date filter on mount when `range` isn't controlled

props.name: outcome
props.description: Which outcomes show – controlled when given

props.name: defaultOutcome
props.description: The outcome filter on mount when `outcome` isn't controlled

changelog: **Audit Trail** (`tc-audit-trail`) – a block showing who did what and when, with search, a filter by outcome and a CSV export that keeps spreadsheet formulas from running.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
